captions.detailed: This 3D-printable model features a customisable ballpoint pen body and its matching cap. The pen body is long and rounded, designed to accommodate a standard ink cartridge, with blocky letters extruded along its length to spell out a custom word. The cap is designed to slide over the tip of the pen, featuring a integrated flat clip on one side. Thin, circular helper tabs are included at the far ends of the model to prevent warping during printing.
captions.instruction: Design a customizable, 3D-printable pen body and cap in OpenSCAD that can fit a standard ballpoint pen refill. The pen body should feature a custom word extruded along its shaft, with parameters to adjust the word text, font scale, pen thickness, and cartridge dimensions, as well as optional helper tabs for printing.
captions.factory: The script uses three main modules: 'wordpen', 'pen', and 'lid'. The pen body is constructed using cylinders and cubes aligned to form a rounded rectangular profile, which is then hollowed out using 'difference' with cylinders representing the inner ink tube and tip. The custom text is generated by iterating over the characters in the word using a 2D font representation, applying 'linear_extrude' with a polygon, and positioning each letter. The lid is constructed similarly with combined cylinders and cubes, hollowed out with a tolerance-adjusted 'lid_hole' to fit snugly over the pen tip.
